_comment: Settings for the 'The Almond today' panel (lib/Views/AlmondTodayPanel.tsx).

demo._demo: While the sensor is offline, replay its own past readings (same time of day, cycling through the last replayDays days before it went offline), clearly labelled Demo. Set enabled to false, or add ?demo=0 to the address, to turn off.

waterQuality._standards: SEPA river standards for lowland, high-alkalinity rivers (Scotland River Basin Management Planning Directions 2014; UKTAG). Official classification uses a year of samples (10th or 90th percentile); this panel applies the same boundaries to the latest reading, so it is indicative only.

tests.label: Ammonia (as N)
tests._factor: Proteus reports ammonium (NH4) in mg/l; standards are total ammonia as nitrogen, so multiply by 14/18.

rainfall._comment: SEPA rain gauges inside the catchment (KiWIS). Totals are the average of the gauges. Daily totals run 09:00 to 09:00.

floodWarnings._comment: SEPA's live flood warning feed needs an access request (ffw@sepa.org.uk); until then the panel links to SEPA's flood updates.

riverCheck._comment: 'Can I get in the river today?' card (lib/Views/RiverCheck.tsx). Indicative only, not health advice. Thresholds are starting guesses to be agreed with SEPA / Forth Rivers Trust. The worst signal sets the answer.
riverCheck._flow: Flow compared with the gauge's long-term percentiles: above Q10 (top 10% of flows) = avoid, above Q30 = caution. Rising fast = up by risingFactor or more over risingHours while above the median = avoid.
riverCheck._waterQuality: Sensor Poor/Bad = avoid, Moderate = caution. When there is no live reading (offline, demo replay or not signed in) the answer is at best caution, since we can't rule a problem out.
